correctness.rationale: For x=3u, G(u)=3u^3-u is a 3-adic isometry and gives exactly 3 roots to each target multiple of 9 at levels k≥2. For x=±(1+3u), the outputs are ±(-2+27u²(u+1)); exactly nine input lifts correspond to each u mod 3^(k-3). Hensel gives one root in each simple residue ball for t≡0 or 2 mod3; u=3v gives 9v²(1+3v), and v↦v√(1+3v) is an isometric bijection, so the critical count is 3Q_(m-2)(t/9) for m≥3 with explicit small cases m=1,2. Quadratic root valuations then give all fibers, maxima and exact maximizing targets. Standalone verify.py was replayed: 29,773 target comparisons including full enumeration k=1..9 and selected independent root lifts k=10..14. Infinite proof does not rely on finite checks.

value.rationale: A natural and previously omitted quantity in the same singular 3-adic cubic is the exact cardinality of each preimage. The result distinguishes overlapping Hensel-simple and critical square-map contributions, provides a complete target-wise infinite classification (not a finite table), and derives sharp two-target maxima that alternate by parity of the modulus exponent. The image count alone cannot provide these data and the precise worst-collision invariant is motivated by nonuniformity of singular residue maps.
